content.text:
Custom structured outputs are supported by **mistral-large-2407, mistral-large-2402, mistral-small-2402, and codestral-latest**.

The `chat.parse` call with a Pydantic `response_format` raises a JSON decode error on other models because those models return plain text instead of JSON-conformant output.

[Structured Outputs – Supported models](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/structured-outputs#supported-models)
[chat.completions – response_format](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/chat-completions#response_format)
